sqlGroup.select: select a.`action`, '1' as flag from sys_func a left join sys_menu b on a.menuid = b.id left join sys_rela_role_auth c on a.id = c.authId and c.authType='2' left join sys_rela_role_user d on d.roleId = c.roleId where a.`action` = #{action} and a.actionType = '2' and b.url = #{controllerKey} and d.userId = #{userId}
sqlGroup.delete:
delete from sys_func where id in
#{id}
